PatientPath

"From Fax to Fast: Modernizing Medical Record Exchange"

PatientPath is a secure digital platform designed to replace outdated fax-based medical record exchange with faster, more reliable, and more transparent sharing between healthcare providers. By improving the movement of referrals, records, and patient information, PatientPath aims to reduce delays, lower administrative burden, and support better coordinated care.

Explore the Solution View Presentation See Deliverables

Project Overview

Healthcare organizations still struggle with fragmented communication, delayed referrals, and inefficient record exchange. PatientPath addresses these challenges through a secure, web-based system that enables providers to share records digitally, track transfer status, and support interoperability across different healthcare environments.

Rather than functioning as a full electronic health record system, PatientPath focuses on one critical gap: secure, efficient cross-organization exchange of patient information.

Problem

Fax-based workflows remain slow, error-prone, and difficult to track across healthcare organizations.

Problem Statement

Medical record transfer methods are often inefficient, disconnected, and dependent on outdated communication tools. When providers rely on fax-based systems, records may be delayed, incomplete, unreadable, or lost entirely. These breakdowns can slow referrals, postpone treatment, increase duplicate testing, and create frustration for both providers and patients.

PatientPath is built around the idea that patients should not be forced to carry the burden of fragmented healthcare communication.

Read the Full Problem Analysis →

Problem Characteristics

Inefficient Transfers

Records can be delayed, misplaced, or transmitted with missing or illegible pages.

Disconnected Systems

Healthcare systems often lack seamless interoperability across providers and organizations.

Privacy & Security Risk

Outdated workflows can expose sensitive patient information to avoidable security and compliance risks.

Poor Scalability

Legacy communication methods do not scale well across large networks or growing organizations.

Usability Issues

Cluttered workflows and manual handoffs create friction for staff already working under time pressure.

Connectivity Constraints

Some environments, especially rural or under-resourced facilities, need resilience during limited connectivity.

Solution Statement

PatientPath is a secure, centralized digital platform that enables healthcare providers to upload, access, manage, and share patient records without relying on fax machines. It is designed to act as a bridge between organizations, supporting efficient communication while improving visibility, accountability, and security throughout the transfer process.

The platform emphasizes practical healthcare workflow improvement rather than replacing every existing system. Its purpose is to modernize one of the most persistent pain points in healthcare communication: moving patient information quickly and safely.

Read the Full Solution Overview →

Solution Characteristics

Security & Compliance

End-to-end encryption, role-based access control, multi-factor authentication, and audit logging support a HIPAA-aligned architecture.

Interoperability

FHIR/HL7 compatibility and an API-first approach support communication across different healthcare systems.

Workflow Visibility

Digital tracking and clearer handoffs help reduce uncertainty in referrals and record delivery.

Scalability

Cloud-ready architecture supports growth across hospitals, clinics, and private practices.

Reliability

PatientPath is designed to reduce dependence on fragile manual communication processes.

Patient-Centered Design

The system supports faster, more coordinated care by helping the right information reach the right provider at the right time.

Customers, End-Users, and Stakeholders

Customers

Hospitals, private practices, specialty clinics, and healthcare networks seeking a better way to exchange patient records.

End-Users

Providers, office staff, referral coordinators, administrators, and patients interacting with transferred medical information.

Stakeholders

Healthcare organizations, compliance teams, IT staff, clinical staff, and patients who depend on secure and timely access to records.

Project Vision

PatientPath reflects a simple but important idea: patient information should move with the same urgency as patient care. By replacing slow, manual communication with secure digital exchange, PatientPath aims to make healthcare coordination more efficient, more reliable, and more patient-centered.
